newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS MONDAY SOFTER ON KEY UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS MONDAY SOFTER ON KEY UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar was quoted easier against key currencies at the close of Monday's interbank market, weighed down by local importer demand in the case of the U.S. dollar, and tracking overseas market trends in the others.
"Not much happened today. We just saw a little bit of importer demand that pushed the rates a bit higher," one dealer said.

The Zimbabwe dollar ended the day at 11.3140/3240 on the U.S. dollar from 11.3125/3225 on Friday and was at 18.8360/8580 from 18.7300/7500 against sterling as the British unit gained over the U.S. dollar overseas.
It was at 6.5720/5790 from 6.5400/5600 versus the mark and at 2.5170/5180 against the rand from 2.5100/5300.
